files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 [project] kind service and entry-point main.jac; this headless slice has no npm or AI dependencies.

Define node Paper with exact reference fields title:str, author:str, summary:str, source_url:str, tags:list[str] default [], and created_at:datetime|None default None. Runtime jid is generated automatically, not declared as a field.

Import Paper from model.jac. Implement get_paper_details(id:str)->Paper|None using jobj. Implement public walkers save_paper, list_papers and search_papers_by_tag. save_paper attaches a timestamped Paper to root and reports a dict with jid, title, author, summary, tags, source_url, created_at. list_papers reports each Paper on root. search_papers_by_tag reports one dict with papers:list[Paper], filtered by exact tag membership.

signatures.save_paper: walker:pub save_paper { has title:str, author:str, summary:str, tags:list[str], source_url:str; can run with Root entry; }
signatures.list_papers: walker:pub list_papers { can run with Root entry; can gather with Paper entry; }
signatures.search_papers_by_tag: walker:pub search_papers_by_tag { has tag:str; can run with Root entry; can gather with Paper entry; can finish with Root exit; }

verify.steps: Run jac check main.jac and Jac behavior tests. Independently verify the source's five original tests on a clean copy and replay all actual harness calls in a clean workspace.

assumption: Backend slice from Rui/JacProjectFactory/factory/output/repaircenter/Ornith_grad-student-paper-library. Original source pins 0.36.0; an isolated copy without the pin passed Jac 0.36.1 check and all five original behavior tests.
